issues.title: Duplicate cranes in the equipment list
issues.text: Items 77 and 85 are both a main deck crane, and items 78 and 86 both a CTD crane.

issues.title: Azimuth drives listed more than once
issues.text: Items 47 and 49 are both named “Port Side PM Azimuth Drive”; item 76 lists the same drives again as “Azipod 500 kW”.

issues.title: Main engine rating
issues.text: 450 kW in the list of main equipment (item 72) and the specification; 475 kW on the engine room arrangement.

issues.title: Propulsion in the GA metadata
issues.text: The metadata infers cycloidal propulsors from the GA geometry. That is wrong: the engine room arrangement identifies PM azimuth drives, port and starboard.

issues.title: Deadweight
issues.text: 164 t on the GA drawing; 169 t on the lines plan and engine room arrangement.

issues.title: Depth to A-deck
issues.text: 6.60 m on the GA drawing; 6.687 m on the lines plan and engine room arrangement.

issues.title: Tank list in the metadata
issues.text: Does not reconcile with the capacity totals. Use Tank Plan Rev1 (tanks 1–15, 202.42 m³ net) instead.

issues.title: Broken references in the weight calculation
issues.text: Row 8 (ship common systems) of the weight calculation spreadsheet shows #REF! in three cells; its weight and centre of gravity still compute.
